description: Return the upper and lower deviations, and the resulting limits, for one tolerance class at one nominal size, such as 36H7 or 36g6. Uppercase is a hole, lowercase a shaft. Values are millimetres and are deviations from the nominal size. Use this to interpret a toleranced dimension; whether the resulting limits suit a joint is an engineering decision.

designation.description: Tolerance class, e.g. H7 or g6.

name: limits_of_size
title: Limits of Size for a Tolerance Class
